noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

remixable.description: If true, marked platform type will be allowed to be remixed,otherwise a platform type is not allowed to be remixed.

todo.description:
Indicates that this method/field has a known issue that needs to be addressed.
When set on a final method, allows overriding with a warning instead of an error.
The value should point to a JIRA ticket or issue tracking the fix.
